scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" --names "BACKEND,AI,FRONTEND" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix ai-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.train:model: cd ai-service && python training/generate_sample_data.py --samples 15000 --out data/training.csv && python training/train_risk_model.py --data data/training.csv --model-out models/risk_model.joblib --eval
